import os
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
import re, json
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
di,do_=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find vertical bar: >=2 rows where same row pattern of nonzero colors, repeated
    # bar: a column block of distinct colors, each column constant, height>=2
    from collections import defaultdict
    colmap=defaultdict(set)
    for c in range(W):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        nz=[v for v in vals if v]
        if len(nz)>=2 and len(set(nz))==1:
            colmap[c]=nz[0]
    if not colmap: return g
    cs=sorted(colmap)
    barcols=[c for c in cs if all(colmap[c]==colmap[cs[0]] for c in cs) or True]
    # take contiguous block with distinct colors
    bar=[cs[0]]
    for c in cs[1:]:
        if c==bar[-1]+1 and g[0][c]!=g[0][bar[-1]]: bar.append(c)
        else: break
    barcolors=[g[0][c] for c in bar]
    # find shape cells not in bar
    barcells={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in bar if g[r][c]}
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in barcells]
    colors_used={v for _,_,v in cells}
    # template: bbox of one existing shape
    r0=min(r for r,_,_ in cells); r1=max(r for r,_,_ in cells)
    c0=min(c for _,c,_ in cells); c1=max(c for _,c,_ in cells)
    # assume single shape present: template
    tmpl=[[1 if g[r][c] else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # draw each color: for colors present keep original cells; for missing, place relative to bar order
    present=[col for col in barcolors if col in colors_used]
    # anchor: use position of existing shape rows; stack others contiguously in bar order
    # index of colors in bar
    idx={col:i for i,col in enumerate(barcolors)}
    # existing shape rows per color
    exrows={}
    for col in colors_used:
        rs=[r for r,_,v in cells if v==col]; exrows[col]=(min(rs),max(rs))
    anchor=min(exrows[p][0] for p in present)
    # place all colors stacked contiguously starting so that present colors keep original rows
    # compute: top color index among present
    pi=[i for i,col in enumerate(barcolors) if col in colors_used]
    # assume contiguous present colors; place shape i so that shape pi[0] keeps its rows
    h=len(tmpl)
    start_row = anchor - pi[0]*h
    for i,col in enumerate(barcolors):
        rtop=start_row+i*h
        if col in colors_used:
            er0,er1=exrows[col]
            if rtop!=er0:
                # trust original placement
                rtop=er0
        for dr,rowv in enumerate(tmpl):
            for dc,v in enumerate(rowv):
                if v and 0<=rtop+dr<H and 0<=c0+dc<W:
                    out[rtop+dr][c0+dc]=col
    return out

o=transform(di)
print(o==do_)
if o!=do_:
    for r in o: print(r)

src='''def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seed=None
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W-1):
            if g[r][c] and g[r][c+1] and g[r][c]!=g[r][c+1]:
                seed=(r,c); break
        if seed: break
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if seed is None: return g
    from collections import deque
    q=deque([seed]); seen={seed}; bc=set()
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft(); bc.add((r,c))
        for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b] and (a,b) not in seen:
                seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
    cols=sorted({c for _,c in bc}); top=min(r for r,_ in bc)
    barcolors=[g[top][c] for c in cols]
    shape_cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in bc]
    colors_used={v for _,_,v in shape_cells}
    v0=sorted(colors_used)[0]
    rs=[(r,c) for r,c,x in shape_cells if x==v0]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in rs); r1=max(r for r,_ in rs)
    c0=min(c for _,c in rs); c1=max(c for _,c in rs)
    tmpl=[[1 if g[r][c] else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    h=len(tmpl)
    ex={v0:(r0,r1)}
    for r,c,v in shape_cells: out[r][c]=v
    present=sorted(i for i,col in enumerate(barcolors) if col in ex)
    a_j=present[0]; a_top,a_bot=ex[barcolors[a_j]]
    k=0
    for i in range(a_j-1,-1,-1):
        rtop=a_top-(k+1)*h; k+=1
        for dr,rowv in enumerate(tmpl):
            for dc,vv in enumerate(rowv):
                if vv and 0<=rtop+dr<H and 0<=c0+dc<W:
                    out[rtop+dr][c0+dc]=barcolors[i]
    k=0
    for i in range(a_j+1,len(barcolors)):
        rtop=a_bot+1+k*h; k+=1
        for dr,rowv in enumerate(tmpl):
            for dc,vv in enumerate(rowv):
                if vv and 0<=rtop+dr<H and 0<=c0+dc<W:
                    out[rtop+dr][c0+dc]=barcolors[i]
    return out
'''
